events.content: Marvell Technology data-center revenue Q2 fiscal 2027 custom AI silicon electro-optics

**Marvell Technology — Q2 FY2027 AI/Data-Center read-through:** Marvell reported record Q2 FY2027 revenue of **$2.739 billion** for the quarter ended **August 1, 2026**, up **37% year over year** and **13% sequentially**; GAAP diluted EPS was **$0.33** and non-GAAP diluted EPS was **$0.94**. [[1]]

**Data center was the central driver:** Data-center revenue reached **$2.172 billion**, up **46% YoY** and **18% QoQ**, and represented **79%** of company revenue, versus 74% a year earlier. [[2]] This implies that virtually all of Marvell’s near-term growth thesis is now linked to hyperscale AI infrastructure rather than its communications-and-other businesses. [[2]]

**Guidance moved materially higher:** Management guided Q3 FY2027 revenue to **$3.15 billion ±5%**, which at the midpoint implies roughly **15% sequential growth** and more than **50% YoY growth**; it also raised FY2027 revenue expectations to approximately **$12 billion** and FY2028 expectations to approximately **$18 billion**. [[2]] [[3]] Management expects data-center revenue to grow about **60% in FY2027** and more than **60% in FY2028**. [[4]] [[3]]

**Custom AI silicon is shifting from design-win narrative to revenue ramp:** Marvell said its Custom business should accelerate significantly in the second half of FY2027, with growth coming from both **XPU** programs and **XPU-attach** products, including custom NICs and CXL-related products. [[1]] [[4]] The disclosed expanded hyperscaler warrant agreement covers existing custom programs, new design wins, and potential future programs spanning AI inference accelerators, storage controllers, NICs, memory-interface controllers, and near-memory compute. [[4]] The important investment implication is that custom silicon can add a second major AI engine alongside connectivity, but it may also pressure gross margin as its revenue mix rises. [[4]] [[3]]

**Electro-optics/connectivity remains the nearer-term revenue base:** Marvell cited strong demand across connectivity, including **800G and 1.6T scale-out optics**, **51.2T Ethernet switches**, scale-up optical solutions for **NPO/CPO**, and coherent **1.6T ZR/ZR+** modules for data-center interconnect. [[5]] [[6]] Management said 800G demand remains strong, 1.6T is ramping rapidly, and 51.2T products are expected to drive more than a doubling of scale-out-switching revenue during FY2027. [[6]]

- **Custom AI silicon**: The Custom business is expected to accelerate in the second half of FY2027, driven by XPU programs and XPU‑attach products (custom NICs, CXL‑related products).
